defects.description: Grammatical error: the term is used in the nominative case instead of the required genitive case after 'средством'.
The glossary term 'brute force attacks' was translated as 'атаки методом перебора' instead of the required 'атаки методом грубой силы'.
The word 'клетка' (cell/cage) is a hallucination and does not belong in the sentence.
Grammatical error: the term is used in the nominative case instead of the required genitive case after 'корректности'.
